title: Crash under MacOS when creating or importing a project
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in e5ccaa79e2a2d5551369bd6cc1f8ed654a791275

Unable to test in earlier versions.

### System information

Unable to access the menu bar from the project manager.

### Issue description

In order to test the new AccessKit integration, I have compiled e5ccaa79e2a2d5551369bd6cc1f8ed654a791275 with AccessKit-c 0.15.1 under MacOS 12.7.6 on an late 2014 Intel Mac Mini. I am running VoiceOver.

I don't have any export templates, nothing has been changed as far as the configuration is concerned, this is a vanilla setup using an auto-generated app bundle

When I try to import a new project (Godot Steam Audio Demo in this case), or create a new one, Godot crashes.

I am unfortunately unable to test earlier versions as the UI is not usable with VoiceOver.
